status: Bounded negative feasibility; no network fitting, DSP edits, parameter anchor or equivalence claim
interpretation: Cotton is structurally strongest: Single centered with zero delay send; original capture/patch state remains unauthenticated.
Coherence and phase invariance are necessary diagnostics but do not establish unbiased nominal-bin transfer with sparse harmonics or long convolution support.
Other originals contain active modulated delay; Air 2s windows fail minimum frame count.
This protocol provides no dependable broadband source-independent reverb anchor; it does not exclude other estimation methods or properly controlled future recordings.

verification.note: Only ignored scratch decode dependency was removed. All original MP3s were directly redecoded; exact native WAVs and reused controls match.
